title: Rome in 117 CE

validWindow.note: This package targets a single interpretive snapshot. Features must carry their own narrower or broader temporal ranges before publication.

studyArea.note: A working research viewport only. It is not an ancient administrative, defensive, or urban boundary.

terrain.note: Requires a reviewed elevation and land-cover reconstruction.

water.note: The Tiber channel, tributaries, marshes, and engineered water features require dated evidence.

roads.note: No street geometry is included until source provenance and date fit are reviewed.

buildings.note: No inferred building footprints are included in the foundation package.

landmarks.note: Landmarks will be added individually with construction state, evidence class, geometry provenance, and license status.

vegetation.note: Urban gardens, sacred groves, agriculture, and regional cover require separate evidence and uncertainty.

sources.title: Pleiades: A Gazetteer of Past Places
sources.role: Ancient place identity, names, coordinates, bibliography, and linked-place discovery
sources.licenseStatus: Pleiades published content is available under CC BY 3.0; attribution is required.
sources.temporalFit: Broad ancient-place reference rather than a complete 117 CE city plan.
sources.notes: Use identifiers and cited spatial records, not unsupported extrapolation.

sources.title: Stanford Digital Forma Urbis Romae Project
sources.role: Architectural ground-plan evidence from surviving fragments of the Severan Marble Plan
sources.licenseStatus: Website text and images are copyright-protected; reuse requires explicit review or permission.
sources.temporalFit: The Marble Plan dates to 203-211 CE, substantially later than the 117 CE target.
sources.notes: Useful for comparison and bibliography, but neither its date nor its copyright permits direct unreviewed import.

sources.title: Open Heritage 3D - Pantheon
sources.role: High-resolution measured geometry for a surviving Roman monument
sources.licenseStatus: CC BY-NC-SA; commercial and derivative use implications require review.
sources.temporalFit: The surviving Hadrianic Pantheon postdates 117 CE in its completed form.
sources.notes: Do not insert the present measured model as a 117 CE reconstruction without architectural and chronological review.

sources.title: OpenHistoricalMap
sources.role: Dated vector features and contributor-maintained historical geometry
sources.licenseStatus: Open database and tile terms must be reviewed for attribution and derived-data use.
sources.temporalFit: Feature-specific. Every imported object must be checked for start and end dates.
sources.notes: Existing application layers remain exploratory until feature-level provenance is audited.

guardrails: The study-area polygon is a working viewport and must never be presented as an ancient city boundary.
No source may be imported into distributable data until its license and attribution requirements are recorded.
A later source must not be silently treated as evidence for 117 CE without a documented continuity argument.
Generated geometry must remain visibly distinct from attested or measured geometry.
Every published feature must include temporal range, evidence class, confidence, source references, and reviewer status.
